tvShow.name: Fire Country
tvShow.overview: Seeking redemption and a shortened prison sentence, young convict Bode Donovan joins a firefighting program that returns him to his small Northern California hometown, where he and other inmates work alongside elite firefighters to extinguish massive blazes across the region.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: Five years ago, Bode burned down everything in his life, leaving town with a big secret. Now he's back, with the rap sheet of a criminal and the audacity to believe in a chance for redemption with Cal Fire.

episodes.name: The Fresh Prince of Edgewater
episodes.overview: After Bode requests to be transferred to a different city, his future in Edgewater hangs in the balance. Meanwhile, the crew joins forces to protect the town from a treacherous storm.

episodes.name: Where There's Smoke...
episodes.overview: When the crew responds to a call in a remote forest, they come under fire by an outlaw protecting illegal marijuana crops.

episodes.name: Work, Don't Worry
episodes.overview: The crew engages in a search and rescue mission after a building collapses and Division Chief Sharon is forced to make a gut-wrenching decision.

episodes.name: Get Some, Be Safe
episodes.overview: A vegetation fire gets complicated for the crew when a panicked horse refuses to evacuate a burning barn. Meanwhile, Vince's brother Luke, the Cal Fire communications director, makes a surprise visit in town.

episodes.name: Like Old Times
episodes.overview: After a hiker falls from a steep cliff, Bode and Jake put aside their differences to make a daring rescue. Also, Sharon reveals devastating news to Bode.

episodes.name: Happy to Help
episodes.overview: Bode's crew is accused of stealing a designer watch from a fire mop up, and the crew responds to a high-stakes call about an extremely dangerous gas leak.

episodes.name: Bad Guy
episodes.overview: Vince's judgment is compromised when a harrowing rescue of two siblings triggers emotional memories of the night his daughter died in a car accident.

episodes.name: No Good Deed
episodes.overview: An internal investigation is launched after a difficult rescue went awry and a life was lost.

episodes.name: Get Your Hopes Up
episodes.overview: A box truck crashes into the station, causing a power outage and triggering a dangerous fire. Meanwhile, Sharon and Bode's ex-girlfriend, Cara, face multiple medical emergencies.

episodes.name: Mama Bear
episodes.overview: A former inmate firefighter harboring a grudge against Sharon returns to carry out his revenge.

episodes.name: Two Pink Lines
episodes.overview: Bode and his fellow prison inmate firefighters band together with the civilian station 42 crew to battle a monstrous fire that erupts after a plane crash. Meanwhile, the crews welcome a new member to the family.

episodes.name: You Know Your Dragon Best
episodes.overview: The crews work to contain a dangerous forest fire and save a group of environmentalists protesting a housing development.

episodes.name: A Fair to Remember
episodes.overview: The crews respond to mass chaos and injuries when a ride malfunctions at the annual Edgewater town fair. Meanwhile, Sharon receives life-changing news.

episodes.name: False Promises
episodes.overview: A massive tree falls during a reforestation assignment, threatening Eve’s life and forcing Bode to step up and lead the rescue efforts.

episodes.name: My Kinda Leader
episodes.overview: When a massive and unpredictable wildfire breaks out in neighboring Drake Country, the station 42 and third rock crews are called to help aid in the rescue efforts.

episodes.name: A Cry for Help
episodes.overview: An internal investigator suspects Jake of being the serial arsonist setting recent fires, so Bode and the crew take it upon themselves to investigate.

episodes.name: Off the Rails
episodes.overview: The crews respond to the scene of a train crash where the rescue has the potential to spiral out of control when they discover the train is full of illicit cargo, and Robin, an enigmatic modern-day train hopper, helps injured patients.

episodes.name: Watch Your Step
episodes.overview: The station 42 crew responds to an out-of-control blaze at a wellness retreat, and the third rock crew tries to protect one of their own from a dangerous overdose.

episodes.name: At the End of My Rope
episodes.overview: The station 42 and third rock crews respond to a deadly explosion at an abandoned mine. Meanwhile, Bode faces a difficult decision that could have serious consequences

episodes.name: Backfire
episodes.overview: The station 42 and Three Rock crews are called to a backfire started by a private firefighting company to protect a high-end winery but instead threatens to grow out of control.

episodes.name: I Know It Feels Impossible
episodes.overview: The station 42 and Three Rock crews face a daring rescue when a massive mudslide tears through Edgewater. Meanwhile, Bode's freedom is on the line at his parole hearing.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Bode Donovan is a young convict with a troubled past. Hoping to redeem himself and shorten his prison sentence, he volunteers for the California Conservation Camp Program in which prisoners assist the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection, known as Cal Fire. He ends up getting assigned to his hometown in Northern California where he must work alongside former friends, other inmates, and elite firefighters putting out the huge fires that plague the region.

episodes.name: Something's Coming
episodes.overview: Bode is back in prison where he receives some shocking news. Meanwhile, the station 42 crew responds to a massive earthquake that rocks Edgewater to its core.

episodes.name: Like Breathing Again
episodes.overview: While breaking up a bonfire party, the station 42 crew is called to complete a dangerous and highly complex cave rescue.

episodes.name: See You Next Apocalypse
episodes.overview: When a family refuses to evacuate their property during a massive wildfire that is escalating quickly, Jake is faced with a heartbreaking decision.

episodes.name: Too Many Unknowns
episodes.overview: The station 42 and third rock crews respond to a chemical plant after a dangerous toxic spill goes up in flames.

episodes.name: This Storm Will Pass
episodes.overview: The station 42 crew must protect Edgewater and take cover when an extremely rare and dangerous fire tornado leaves lives in peril.

episodes.name: Alert the Sheriff
episodes.overview: After a fire camp inmate escapes from Three Rock, the deputy sheriff with a surprising connection to the Leones, Mickey, is called to investigate.

episodes.name: A Hail Mary
episodes.overview: The future of Three Rock is in jeopardy as public opinion of the camp grows increasingly negative.

episodes.name: It's Not Over
episodes.overview: With the future of Three Rock in jeopardy, Station 42 and Three Rock host Edgewater's 22nd Annual Firefighters' Ball in an effort to impress the governor and save the camp. Meanwhile, Gabriela's mom, Roberta, makes a surprise appearance at the event.

episodes.name: No Future, No Consequences
episodes.overview: Station 42 and Three Rock battle a dangerous campaign fire where our heroes struggle with difficult decisions.

episodes.name: I Do
episodes.overview: Gabriela prepares to walk down the aisle on her wedding day as Bode receives some surprising news.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In the second season, Bode Donovan fights to clear his name and secure his early release from the Three Rock prison camp after taking the fall for a drug test to protect a fellow inmate. Once cleared and released, Bode ultimately chooses to leave his ex-girlfriend Gabriela's wedding to prioritize her happiness, seeking a new path as a free civilian and a legacy firefighter.

episodes.name: What the Bride Said
episodes.overview: In the midst of Gabriela and Diego's wedding, a helicopter crash ignites chaos and the team immediately jumps into action to stop fires and help victims.

episodes.name: Firing Squad
episodes.overview: Bode receives a life-changing opportunity that could impact his future as a firefighter.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Cult
episodes.overview: Bode and Gabriela consider confessing a huge secret they have been hiding.

episodes.name: Keep Your Cool
episodes.overview: The temperature is high and tensions are even higher when the crew has to execute an advanced elevator rescue during a heat-induced power outage.

episodes.name: Edgewater's About to Get Real Cozy
episodes.overview: Station 42 and Three Rock jump into action when an airplane makes an emergency landing outside of Edgewater.

episodes.name: Not Without My Birds
episodes.overview: When a fire breaks out in a park containing an eagle nest, Station 42 and Three Rock work to rescue the protected species and prevent the fire from spreading into town.

episodes.name: False Alarm
episodes.overview: Station 42 responds to a false alarm call that escalates into a dangerous hostage situation.

episodes.name: Promise Me
episodes.overview: When a series of dangerous underground zombie fires emerge, the team must protect the town, forcing Eve to have a less-than-warm reunion with her estranged father, Elroy Edwards.

episodes.name: Coming In Hot
episodes.overview: With the Chezem Valley fire blazing out of control, Bode and Audrey must find a way to save themselves; Manny risks his freedom for his missing daughter; and Eve tries to protect her father and their family's ranch.

episodes.name: The Leone Way
episodes.overview: The Leone men attempt a daring rescue while on a family fishing trip and Sharon faces a tough decision when a baby is safely surrendered at station 42.

episodes.name: Fare Thee Well
episodes.overview: The crew responds to a call from the local renaissance fair after a fire breather loses their balance and sets off a tent filled with fireworks.

episodes.name: I'm the One Who Just Goes Away
episodes.overview: While on a risk assessment trip to the Trinity National Forest, Bode and Jake attempt a daring rescue despite avalanche danger.

episodes.name: My Team
episodes.overview: Station 42 responds to a fire in the dugout before the annual county clash baseball rivalry game; Vince's ex-girlfriend returns.

episodes.name: Death Trap
episodes.overview: The station 42 crew responds to a wellness check at the home of a hoarder that escalates into a full-blown house fire; Vince and Sharon are forced to face the reality of his father's ballooning cognitive troubles.

episodes.name: One Last Time
episodes.overview: Bode and Jake respond to a lighthouse rescue operation that turns into a mission to prevent a ship from crashing during an intense storm. Eve investigates the origins of a flu outbreak at Three Rock.

episodes.name: Dirty Money
episodes.overview: Bode and his aunt, Sheriff Mickey Fox, investigate the attempted murder of her estranged father, Wes Fox, Mickey’s estranged father and Sharon’s stepfather who runs an illegal marijuana business.

episodes.name: Fire and Ice
episodes.overview: The station 42 crew responds to a ski resort accident after a chair lift malfunctions, and Vince struggles to connect with his father.

episodes.name: Eyes and Ears Everywhere
episodes.overview: The station 42 crew responds to a routine house fire that escalates into a dangerous situation for one of their own.

episodes.name: A Change in the Wind (1)
episodes.overview: When a fire erupts at a gas station, Bode and Manny jump into action to protect the patrons and property.

episodes.name: I'd Do It Again (2)
episodes.overview: Extremely high winds and dangerous conditions push the Zebel Ridge fire into Edgewater, threatening Three Rock and Walter's care facility.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The third season centers on Bode Donovan’s pursuit of civilian firefighting and features chaotic personal arcs. The season opens with a massive helicopter crash interrupting Gabriela and Diego's wedding, immediately thrusting everyone into emergency response mode.

episodes.name: Goodbye for Now
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of the Zabel Ridge fire, Station 42 faces internal turmoil but must rally together for a high-stakes rescue that tests their strength, loyalty and the future of the firehouse.

episodes.name: Not a Stray
episodes.overview: Station 42 faces a high-stakes wildfire situation that tests their unity, leadership and personal resilience; the new battalion chief is on site, but he has a polarizing leadership style that gets under everyone's skin.

episodes.name: The Tiny Ways We Start to Heal
episodes.overview: The Station 42 team responds to a dangerous zipline accident that escalates into a wildfire due to illegal fireworks; Sharon struggles with letting go of Vince's belongings and unexpectedly finds comfort in Vince's ex, Renee.

episodes.name: Like a Wounded Wildebeest
episodes.overview: When Station 42 responds to a call for a rescue at a grain silo, Manny and Jake butt heads over differing approaches. Manny has a serious conversation with Bode about a troubling discovery.

episodes.name: Happy First Day, Manny
episodes.overview: The team responds to a dangerous fire at the local drive-in movie theater where they must enlist civilians to help stop the spread; Bode and Sharon wrestle with the weight of holding secrets from each other.

episodes.name: Your Voice in My Head
episodes.overview: Station 42 responds to a dangerous fire at a beloved local smokehouse where Jake is forced to confront memories of his late father and the place they once shared.

episodes.name: Best Mom in the World
episodes.overview: Sharon is blindsided by a visit from her estranged mother, Ruby, whose sudden reappearance stirs up painful family history. Meanwhile, Bode and Jake respond to a call from a troubled teen in a condemned building.

episodes.name: Fresh Start
episodes.overview: Bode participates in a high school drunk-driving drill that unexpectedly reconnects him with a former classmate, Chloe. Meanwhile, Three Rock reopens with a new crew and high hopes.

episodes.name: Who Owns the Dirt
episodes.overview: When a red flag warning sets the stage for a volatile day, a turf war between Station 42 and neighboring Drake County comes to a head.

episodes.name: On the Carpet
episodes.overview: As a massive wildfire pushes station 49 to their limits, tough calls on the front lines spark even tougher questions back at headquarters.

episodes.name: Elite of the Elite
episodes.overview: As Bode fights to prove himself during the high-stakes REMs tryouts, a shocking leak about the Zabel Ridge arsonist ignites turmoil across Edgewater.

episodes.name: Life of a Firefighter
episodes.overview: As Station 42 battles through a relentless shift, the unexpected return of Battalion Chief Brett Richards throws the crew off balance and forces Manny to confront his growing self-doubt.

episodes.name: The Bravest (II)
episodes.overview:
With the clock ticking and the fate of nine missing students on the line, Bode and Deputy Nathan Boone must risk it all in order to save innocent lives.

The crossover starts on Sheriff Country S01E013 The Finest (I).

episodes.name: Why Not Now?
episodes.overview: A day of celebration at the Edgewater rodeo erupts into chaos after a stampede of runaway horses endangers the crowd.

episodes.name: Making Things Go Boom
episodes.overview: A routine response to a reported minor fire turns dangerous when the Station 42 team discovers the threat is far greater than dispatch indicated.

episodes.name: Not Worth the Risk
episodes.overview: Bode sets out to prove his leadership skills during a historic cold snap that plunges Edgewater into crisis mode. Meanwhile, Jake contemplates a life‑altering decision that could change his future forever.

episodes.name: Sometimes the Chaos Wins
episodes.overview: When a powerful storm sends a massive telephone pole crashing through a family home and traps a woman inside, station 42 races against time to try and pull off a dangerous rescue.

episodes.name: Best Man
episodes.overview: When Bode’s past resurfaces far from Edgewater, a volatile chain of events leads to a perilous off-duty rescue that forces him to confront guilt, accountability and what it truly means to step up when lives – and friendships – are on the line.

episodes.name: Rain Check for Tomorrow?
episodes.overview: When a volatile blaze at the Pineville Dam triggers a cascading infrastructure failure, Station 42 races to execute a series of perilous rescues.

episodes.name: Try Not to Drown
episodes.overview: After a catastrophic dam failure unleashes historic floodwaters across Edgewater, Station 42 and Three Rock battle rising waters and dwindling resources.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The fourth season centers on Station 42 and the Three Rock inmate firefighters as they navigate the devastating emotional fallout of losing beloved patriarch Vince Leone in a catastrophic memory care facility fire. With new leadership clashing with the crew and historic floods threatening Edgewater, the season focuses on Bode's continued pursuit of redemption, reconciling with his past, and finding closure.

episodes.name: Founders' Day
episodes.overview: As Edgewater celebrates its annual Founders' Day festival, a catastrophic sinkhole opens beneath Main Street, trapping residents underground and forcing Station 42 into a high-stakes rescue. Meanwhile, a mysterious former firefighter arrives in Edgewater.

reviews.author: GenerationofSwine
reviews.content:
Oh boy.

At it's heart this is a series about slave labor in California... where all the leftists in Hollywood's new propaganda entertainment live.  You know, the "bastion of progressiveness."  The place that is the fastest to point out that slavery in the past was so bad people in the present are guilty of it and people in the future will be just as guilty as the people that actually owned slaves...

... it is about slavery in THAT state.  A sort of Romanesque we are going to force criminals to risk their lives for the state sort of slavery.

it's sort of gladiatorial combat against fire sort of slavery... that is honestly really happening in California... a desert community that unironically has constant wildfires because it doesn't back burn because of the environment... even though it releases less carbon than a wild fire.

It's Slaves v Wildfire.

But it's really entertaining, sort of like Backdraft the TV show where the firemen are slaves... in California... and is based on real slavery... in California.

So it is really edge of your seat popcorn munching Chicago Fire wishes it was this exciting entertainment...

Only about actual slavery that is actually happening... in CALIFORNIA.
